newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lowest EU refund bid in France for 1,000 T wheat.
newsitem.headline: Lowest EU refund bid in France for 1,000 T wheat.

text.p: The lowest subsidy bid placed in France to export European Union wheat involved only some 1,000 tonnes of free-market soft wheat, grain trade sources said on Thursday.
The lowest bid placed to export European Union barley with a subsidy was for 25,000 tonnes, they also said.
In France traders bid to export to non-EU destinations a total of 657,750 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at subsidies ranging from 4.47 to 12.99 Ecus per tonne.
Operators also asked to export 496,000 tonnes of free market EU barley at subsidies from 29.77 to 38.47 Ecus per tonne
